Never execute an event to derive the metadata. Original event/parent/ledger order remains exact.
PROJECTION: For each explicitly owned selected checkpoint and exact prefix, enumerate every prefix-available pin and invoke existing native LOAD_PIN once per pin. Stable sorting organizes job records only; source collection is semantically unordered. Do not merge foreign checkpoint collections or use future additions in earlier prefixes.
